conditions: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

Rubber-block printing onto paper and shared reading of that printed work must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

assigned_direction.content_form: One wide scene joins block contact, continuous paper and shared reading. Moderate title/large timing sit above; activity and three attendance columns sit below.
assigned_direction.whole_expression_style: Intimate cinematic adult programme: the continuous encounter leads; literary Korean and numerical timing frame its upper edge, with broad horizontal facts below.
assigned_direction.reference_transfer: Mut: atmosphere travels through a shared making/gathering hierarchy. Replace its bloom with a continuous action scene and larger facts. SABF’s plain factual unit becomes the wide attendance band.

layout.large_relationship: One uninterrupted scene fills [0,82,720,195]. Title upper left, timing upper right. Activity directly below starts three unequal attendance columns. No internal scene panels or central giant object.
layout.alignment: Title/activity/venue x24; timing x420. Lower fee/application x270 and preparation/welcome x530 share identical row heights.
layout.visible_reading_route: First the wide shared-reading encounter; its upper edge leads to title and adjacent date/time. Activity below leads to venue/entry, then across the common row level to fee/application and preparation/welcome. Lower facts are three useful pairs.

typography.roles: Korean title: controlled high-contrast serif display 36 px semibold. Timing: condensed tabular sans 25/22 px, clear en dash. Page English: upright editorial capitals 25 px. Activity 20 px; venue/entry 19/18 px; other facts regular humanist sans 17 px.
typography.image_type_boundary: English belongs only to the frontal held page. Other copy sits on flat high-contrast bands outside the photo; no face overlays.

image.scene: Eye-level panoramic adult table encounter. At left a hand lifts the edge of a carved rubber block from paper, revealing its imprint. At right two adult neighbours support and read the same broad sheet, one speaking while the other follows the large English line.
image.action_relation: One continuous paper reaches from block contact to readers’ grips. Its distinctive nonletter motif matches inked rubber underside, fresh mark and reader-facing end. English is the page’s only wording. Distinct wrists, paper grips, rubber thickness and contact prevent floating or fused parts.
image.crop: Keep both reading faces, gripping hand, slab face/thickness, whole imprint and page line. Bodies may crop at shoulders/table edge; wording is near-horizontal.

assigned_direction.material: Consistent realistic photo depiction with soft side light/shadow plus crisp graphic bands. No film captions, word-covering grain or wall mockup.
assigned_direction.color: Blue-black bands/light copy; warm amber light and petrol scene shadows. Pale paper clearly separates contact and reading target from the table.
assigned_direction.emotion: Warm, attentive adult night out with enough visual drama for a community digital screen.
